vb_textbox.text: There are two different coloured baskets. Different groups of gnomes will show you different baskets. Each basket has between 1 and 9 mushrooms. Identify which group of gnomes give you the basket with the higher number of mushrooms. After a while the pattern changes, once the number of mushrooms drop below 5 try selecting the other group to see if they give you a higher number of mushrooms. Sometimes, it is not based on the colour of the gnome, it is based on whether they are on the left or right. As previous, when the number of mushrooms drop, find a different pattern.
